description: 'Generate the full structured PR description from SDLC artifacts'
---
Using requirements.md, architecture.md, design-review.md, impl-plan.md, and
the latest verification report, generate a PR description with these sections:

- Summary
- Changes Made
- Test Evidence
- Known Limitations
- Reviewer Checklist

Pull real content only — mark anything unavailable as "Not Found."
